organic_results.snippet: Survivors include his son, Efrain Pineda Jr.; his daughters, Charlene Castro, Lisa Oaxaca, Loretta Dominguez and Suzanne Levison; and 12 grandchildren. He was a business owner for 32 years and an Army veteran. El Paso Times - Jun 3 2000.
